S.FORM: alang Tkasan ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 19 buwan, 57 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 54 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 3 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 95%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Tkasan hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Tkasan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Tkasan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Tkasan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Tkasan hya' ga Raka. tay 'zil na Tkasan hya' ga Kuli. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tka[s|ɕ]an ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa raka taj ʔzil na tka[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa kuli reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
